body: The sound of the ferry horn reverberates through the air, echoing my confusion as I stand frozen on the dock edge. My pulse quickens at the sight before me—a small, metallic object floating gently towards the shore. Intrigued but cautious, I take a few steps forward, my boots sinking slightly into the soft sand. As I get closer, the object—indeed, it turns out to be an old, rusted lifeboat—comes into view. Its deck is battered from years of saltwater exposure, yet somehow still functional despite its worn-out state. An instinct drives me to inspect each inch, eager to uncover what secrets this forgotten vessel holds.
